classification_reasons: Spec is tight: three open questions answered, the one flagged concern (version) decided by panel #1, acceptance measurable.

Blast radius is not small in kind: the HTTP transport's opener is rebuilt by hand (every download goes through it), and pyproject.toml gains a new Windows-only runtime dependency and a [tool.setuptools] packaging table.

Coverage: the new behaviour is covered by the 20 new parametrized cases; existing with_retries/Vision/REST tests cover the error paths through urllib_fetch. The packaging half (R9, R10, Windows tzdata) has no automated test and rests on the owner's Windows check at deploy.
attempted: Intent: all three outcomes addressed. Redirects are not followed and non-https schemes are refused (http.py opener); a datetime bound raises InvalidRequestError (params.parse_date); tzdata declared for win32 only with packages named so `pip install -e .` can build. CI workflow and guardrails untouched; the guardrail lines that go stale (CLAUDE.md Setup and runtime-dependency line, sdlc.yaml commands.setup) are named in plan.md for the owner, with the merge-order caveat.

Spec and plan: R1-R13 checked against the diff. Code diff touches exactly the files plan.md lists (tests/test_data.py, app/data/http.py, app/data/params.py, pyproject.toml, .gitignore, plan.md). Commit order matches the order of work: reproducing tests (ff61d01), parse_date, opener, packaging, verifier. The handler list, comment and error message match plan steps 2-4 word for word. plan.md updated in the diff with the Linux `pip install -e . --no-deps` result.

Proof: failing-test.log is literal pytest output on the pre-fix tree: 20 failed, matching the 20 new cases (10 redirect, 3 scheme, 6 datetime, 1 clear_cache), with the expected failure modes (redirect followed 4 more times, Connection refused / file read, TypeError). verifier.md exercises the changed behaviour directly: redirect statuses, schemes with socket.connect patched to raise, handler list, proxy tunnel through _HTTPSHandler, datetime refusals in make_request/load_klines/clear_cache, and unchanged date/string paths. Build/test/lint logs are the runner's in this CI session (verifier 'read, not run'), not missing proof.

Blast radius: callers of urllib_fetch (loader default fetch, CLI) and of parse_date (make_request, cache.clear_cache lines 146-147) checked. 4xx/5xx/418/429 still become HTTPError -> HttpResponse through HTTPErrorProcessor + HTTPDefaultErrorHandler; a 3xx takes the same path, so vision.py:60 and rest.py:68 report 'refused (HTTP 3xx)' and with_retries returns it without retrying (status < 500). ProxyHandler traced: an https request with an http(s) proxy sets a tunnel and falls through to _HTTPSHandler (timeouts kept); an http/ftp request with an env proxy either returns None or re-enters open() as http and still hits UnknownHandler, so env proxies do not reopen plain http. No risk-list item, no schema, cache layout or public API change; no guardrail file in the diff.

Policies: security-baseline (bounded transport, TLS context untouched, tests open no external socket; the scheme test opens nothing after the fix), coding-standards (type hints on new tests, ruff clean per hooks, new dependency carries its Risks line), ux-and-brand rule 4 (message says what happened and what to pass). Data conventions not applicable.

Tests: could they pass with the bug present? No: the redirect test asserts only the origin URL was opened and the status equals the 3xx; the scheme test requires 'unknown url type' (pre-fix gives Connection refused or reads the file); the datetime tests require 'not a datetime'; the clear_cache test seeds a day file so the pre-fix TypeError path is reached, and asserts the file survives. Fix-type rule: tests/test_data.py gains imports and appended tests only, all in the reproducing commit that precedes the fix; no existing test modified, weakened or deleted.
Skip markers: none added in the diff (searched for skip/xfail).

Claims against today's code: checked _OPENER = build_opener(_HTTPSHandler()) at http.py (removed line), urllib_fetch's except HTTPError conversion, with_retries returning status < 500 other than 418/429, _HTTPSConnection/CONNECT_TIMEOUT/READ_TIMEOUT/MAX_BODY_BYTES, vision.py:60 and rest.py:68 refusal messages, parse_date at params.py:77 returning any date, clear_cache calling parse_date at cache.py:146, binance_stub.cached_days used by existing tests, pyproject dependencies = ['polars>=1.0'] and version 0.1.0, app/ containing only app and app.data packages (so packages = ['app', 'app.data'] is complete). All hold.
Drive: not applicable (no commands.drive evidence or drive files in plan.md).
